## Change

Describe the user problem and resulting behaviour. Link the specification when applicable.

## Validation

List checks actually run and their results. Link CI for the exact commit. Distinguish automated tests from browser checks and mention any blocked checks.

## Demo

Link a video or screenshots showing the changed behaviour. Note the repositories/scenarios used and any editing or time compression.

## Review notes

Describe the relevant risks, compatibility, limits and failure behaviour. Include migration or rollback steps when needed.

## Documentation

Link updated usage documentation, testing notes and project memory as applicable.
